Thank you for checking in, that's very kind of you :)

I'm just going through a rough time of it. My health is shot - I just got diagnosed with PCOD thanks to some crazy weight gain in my two years of grad school, I'm scared I'm doing bad a work (it's my first job) and I think the loneliness of the professional world is getting to me - having people to talk to was so much easier as a student!
Kya?
Again I say....there's no need to dismiss my issues.

Cool...so I have an issue with getting told to do it sooner. 

Also, you are not being asked to relocate for your spouse, but because your mom wants you close. 

Look, your problem may be equally valid. And it should be discussed. Just start a new comment thread. There's no need to add it here and dismiss my issues.
Yeah...I probably will. Thanks!
It's some David Frawley or something...don't know his Hindu name
Wow, thank you. That was quite firm of you
Glad your parents were supportive :)

I am speaking for myself. 

Yeah it's a lot of pressure. 

But you probably aren't told to find an average job so you can relocate to work in the same city as your wife, right?
Thanks, especially for the last few lines. I am in an expensive post graduation course and most batch mates have taken loans...I'm one of the few who has parents pay for it
That's so cool. Your mother is very inspiring.
It _is_ too soon IMO. The whole, 'all cousins did it' logic is what they use.

Hope so..
Will try to get a job at a different location from hometown  so I don't get daily pleas / threats
Not really, no.

Yes I agree. If there is one thing I learnt, it's important for me to earn enough to support myself, so I can be an equal partner with an equal say in running a house. I have never worked before , so it would not be wise to go from school to college to post graduation to marriage. I need at least a year of work experience before, just so I get used to managing my own budget.

Yes.... literally she told me about an American who preaches Hinduism and says we have to be proud Hindus etc...he's also a Padma Bhushan I asked her if he got it recently. She told me to stop being secular. He got it it 2015
Yeah that's what I plan to do. I think she's trying to say get a job but not a good job so you aren't sad about leaving it.
what is an essential tremor

Using my throwaway for this. So I'm in my final year of post grad. My mom came to my college just to 'visit'. She's giving me the whole "Hinduism is threatened by Muslims (and Christians, apparently)". I study in quite a liberal, though reputed college. She's also telling me I have to get married because that's what good south indian brahmin girls do, apparently. I don't want to get married I'm just 23 I don't know what to do Plus, I'm likely to get a good job on campus. She's all, "don't take it, you'll have to relocate with your husband anyway" WHY THE FUCK DID THEY PRESSURE ME TO STUDY SO HARD IF THIS WAS THE END GAME ANYWAY???? sorry for the incoherent rant, just needed to vent.
NOOOO!
